{{Top|leg}}
'''Operation Noble Gambit''' was a two-part military operation carried out by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Battle of the Archenar asteroid field|wiped out]] Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in the [[Archenar asteroid field]], and [[Battle of Makem Te (Cold War)|destroyed]] the Imperial warship [[Overlord (warship)|''Overlord'']] above [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]].
